author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a freezing of the VPN laws coming into effect. Utah as a state has been sued by the sites most affected by these laws, but I won't ever forget it was their negligence that caused this whole nightmare. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: Finally Some Good News…
